card.title: IPhone XR freezes at the last digit of the pin code

source.title: IPhone XR freezes at the last digit of the pin code

symptoms: freezes at last passcode digit then restarts

claims.statement: iPhone XR freezing at the last passcode digit usually has a hairline-cracked NFC chip U_NFC_S above the CPU; after replacing it the phone goes through a 'swipe to recover' / Attempting Data Recovery step (10–20 min).

procedure: Let the data recovery screen complete.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
